description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340151199872 ANODE,CORROSION PRE: Line 0001 Qty 513 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0079 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
